grammar_concept.title: Advanced Cohesive Devices
grammar_concept.rule: Beyond everyday connectors like "however" or "as a result", formal and academic English uses a set of higher-register cohesive devices to link ideas precisely: "notwithstanding" (despite, in spite of), "insofar as" (to the extent that), "whereby" (by which, through which), and "thereby" (by that means, as a result of that action). Each has a specific grammatical slot and cannot simply substitute for a basic connector.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: These go beyond the B2 connectors ("nevertheless", "furthermore", "as a result") already covered: "notwithstanding" often follows its noun ("the delay notwithstanding") or precedes it like a preposition ("notwithstanding the delay"); "whereby" introduces a relative clause explaining a mechanism ("a system whereby..."); "thereby" links an action to its consequence within the same sentence ("..., thereby reducing costs"); "insofar as" limits a claim to a specific extent ("insofar as that is possible").
grammar_concept.example: The policy, notwithstanding its critics, was approved. The company introduced a system whereby employees can work remotely. The team automated the process, thereby reducing errors. The plan is sound, insofar as it addresses the budget.
grammar_concept.example_translation: A política, apesar dos seus críticos, foi aprovada. A empresa introduziu um sistema através do qual os funcionários podem trabalhar remotamente. A equipa automatizou o processo, reduzindo assim os erros. O plano é sólido, na medida em que aborda o orçamento.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a tratar estas palavras como sinónimos diretos de "but"/"so", usando-as em qualquer posição da frase ("Notwithstanding, the policy was approved" isolado, sem objeto) ou confundindo "whereby" com "where" por semelhança superficial, quando "whereby" introduz um mecanismo/processo, não um lugar.
grammar_concept.correction: "Notwithstanding" precisa de um objeto (nome ou oração) antes ou depois; "whereby" só se usa para descrever um sistema/processo pelo qual algo acontece, nunca um lugar físico; "thereby" liga sempre uma ação ao seu efeito na mesma frase, geralmente com um gerúndio a seguir.
grammar_concept.real_world_example: In a legal or corporate document: "The board approved a mechanism whereby shareholders can vote remotely, thereby increasing participation."

vocabulary.definition_en: in spite of; without being affected by
example_sentences: Notwithstanding the delay, the project was completed on budget.

vocabulary.definition_en: by which; through which (a process or system)
example_sentences: They created a system whereby customers can track their orders in real time.

vocabulary.definition_en: by that means; as a result of that
example_sentences: They cut the budget, thereby delaying the launch.
The proposal is realistic, insofar as it respects the current budget.

exercises.prompt: Complete: The company introduced a new system ___ employees can work from home two days a week.
exercises.explanation: "Whereby" introduz o mecanismo/processo pelo qual algo acontece — aqui, o sistema que permite trabalhar remotamente.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar "where" sugeriria um local físico, não um processo — "whereby" é a escolha correta para descrever um sistema ou mecanismo.

exercises.prompt: Complete: The team automated the process, ___ reducing the number of errors by half.
exercises.explanation: "Thereby" liga a ação (automatizar) à sua consequência direta (reduzir erros) dentro da mesma frase, seguido de gerúndio.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: "Whereby" não serve aqui porque não há um sistema a ser descrito, apenas uma consequência direta de uma ação — esse é o papel de "thereby".

exercises.explanation: "Notwithstanding" significa "apesar de", equivalente formal a "despite"/"in spite of".

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What does "insofar as" limit here?
correct_answer: the extent to which the plan is realistic
distractors: the total cost of the plan
exercises.explanation: No áudio: "The plan is realistic, insofar as it respects the current budget." — "insofar as" limita a afirmação a essa condição específica.
exercises.transcript: The plan is realistic, insofar as it respects the current budget.

exercises.prompt: Read: "Notwithstanding the budget cuts, the department met all of its targets." Did the budget cuts prevent the department from meeting its targets?
exercises.explanation: "Notwithstanding" = apesar de — os cortes orçamentais NÃO impediram o cumprimento das metas.

exercises.prompt: Translate to English (usando "thereby"): "Eles simplificaram o processo, reduzindo assim os custos."
correct_answer: They simplified the process, thereby reducing costs.
exercises.explanation: "Thereby reducing costs" liga a ação (simplificar) ao seu efeito direto (reduzir custos).
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Traduzir "assim" por "so" produz uma frase gramaticalmente diferente (duas orações separadas) em vez da estrutura fluida com gerúndio que "thereby" permite.

steps.content: These formal connectors carry primary stress on their first syllable (NOT-withstanding, WHERE-by, THERE-by) and are usually set off by commas, with a slight pause before and after in careful, formal speech.

steps.prompt: Describe a system or process at your work or school using 'whereby' — e.g. 'We have a system whereby...'.
Write 3 formal sentences, one each using 'notwithstanding', 'thereby', and 'insofar as'.
